# El Amir Palace

> Lebanese and Mediterranean restaurant in Anzoátegui, Venezuela, open since 1997, with two branches: Lechería and Puerto La Cruz. Dine-in, pickup and delivery; orders are confirmed on WhatsApp. Website in Spanish (default), English and Arabic.

## Key facts
- Name: El Amir Palace (Arabic: قصر الأمير)
- Cuisine: Lebanese, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern; also seafood, rice dishes, pasta and burgers
- Founded: 1997
- Branches (Anzoátegui, Venezuela):
  - El Amir Palace Lechería — phone/WhatsApp 0424-806 0218 (+584248060218)
  - El Amir Palace Puerto La Cruz — phone/WhatsApp 0412-750 5025 (+584127505025)
- Opening hours (America/Caracas): Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu: 11:30–22:00; Fri, Sat: 11:30–23:00; Sun: 11:30–21:00
- Delivery areas: Lechería, Nueva Barcelona, Barcelona, Puerto La Cruz, Guanta; the fee is confirmed on WhatsApp according to the area; pickup at either branch
- Price range: $$ (prices in USD; e.g. shawarma from $8, Arabic platter from $50 for sharing)
- Menu: more than 160 dishes in 14 sections
- Payment: Pago móvil, cash (bolívares or US dollars), Binance, Zinli
- Vegetarian options: hummus, mutabal, falafel, tabbouleh, fattoush, salads
